protocol.ttft: first text-bearing event minus semaphore-admitted request start
protocol.throughput: successful completion token usage / scored duration

fidelity.metric: Token-weighted gold-token raw-logprob MAE against frozen BF16 reference; lower is better
fidelity.head_metric_scope: Raw-logprob requests use full BF16 head; hybrid top1 separately probed on identical hidden states

limitations: One sequential six-point serving run per checkpoint/config; automatic GPU clocks; no confidence intervals.
Earlier measurements supply the matched baselines; no opposing-order paired serving experiment.
FP8 KV + BF16 SSM has not been measured; separate gains cannot be added.
Fidelity measures teacher-forced raw-logprob error, not downstream task accuracy or free-running text agreement.
Main and current optimization profiles have different scheduler, graph, attention and memory settings.
Initial fusion/PDL and historical 4B measurements are separate runs from the checkpoint/KV/SSM comparison.
